agent_note: Third-person present narration across multiple focal characters (Hollis, Dru-Ann, Ethan): 'Hollis glides', 'She stuffs', 'It pains Ethan'. Quotation-mark survival is INCONSISTENT in this book - marks survive in q08103/q08118/q08126 but are stripped from clear speech in q08117/q08119/q08121/q08123, so mark-less quotes were judged on vocatives, direct address, and register (recorded per quote). A cluster of first-person quotes (q08105, q08106, q08109, and arguably q08120/q08124) reads as an embedded first-person reflective/essayistic strand; where direct address or spoken cadence was present I filed them dialogue, otherwise event. The book's only past event quote (q08105) belongs to that strand.
